concerns.text: T004 requires producing 'a preliminary data/results/analysis_results.json with real ... LME entries' and wiring 'main.py (download → preprocess → metrics → analysis)', but the analysis functions (fit_lme, fdr_correct) are only implemented in T006, which depends on T005 → T004. As written, T004 is not executable: no task produces the LME code it must run. Either T004 must be scoped to a stub/thin analysis implemented within it, or a minimal fit_lme implementation must be pulled forward into T004.

T002 bundles four distinct deliverables (bandpass filter, ICA artifact removal, epoching + night-ID extraction, NaN validation) each with its own unit tests and edge-case behavior. Too coarse for deterministic execution; flag for atomization into per-function tasks.

T003 bundles five deliverables (connectivity matrices, centrality, PLI, VIF, subject-level aggregation) across FR-003/004/005/009 with four separate unit tests and a schema-conformance integration test. Too coarse; flag for atomization.

Verification says 'the documented command executes' but no task prior to T004 documents any command (quickstart.md is populated only in T010). Name the exact command in T004 (e.g. 'python code/main.py --subjects 3') so the verification is checkable.

download_sleep_edf(output_dir='data/raw/', n_subjects=...) leaves n_subjects unspecified while the verification requires ≥ 30 subjects; pin the value (e.g. n_subjects=30 or the full Sleep-EDF ST subset) so the deliverable is deterministic.
